name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-05-23, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.78 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
